Our Story

Where Beauty Meets Care

Marina Men's Barber & Spa is a premium beauty and wellness destination in Salmiya, bringing together expert stylists, therapists, and estheticians under one roof. From everyday grooming to bridal glam and deep relaxation, every visit is designed around you.

From hair and skin to nails and grooming, our team is trained to bring out your natural confidence — in a space designed for you to relax and be pampered.
